source_text: In Sudanese discourse, such texts are invoked to frame FGM—particularly Type I or "sunna" circumcision—as a recommended (mustahabb) practice akin to male ritual, though critics emphasize that even if authentic, they do not mandate excision or infibulation prevalent in the region.
